note: Rewritten from the Diagnostic characters of entry 41, Odontotermes girnarensis Thakur, in that book, the original in English; the original records only two castes (Caste known : Soldier and worker) and no alate description. Original description: Thakur, R. K. 1989, Indian For. Rec. (N.S.), Ent. 15(1): 46—49. Type locality: Bordevi, Girnar Hills (Junagarh), Gujarat, India. Specimens examined 18 vials (1964—1981), from 9 districts of Gujarat.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to dark brown, nearly square. Mandibles pale brown, paler at the base. Body length (including mandibles) 5.45—5.58 mm, head length (including mandibles) 2.55—2.75 mm (1.50—1.66 mm excluding mandibles), maximum head width 1.28—1.40 mm. Antennae 16-segmented, segment 1 longest, segment 4 shortest, apical segment oval. Labrum ligulate, longer than wide (length 0.34—0.38 mm, width 0.31—0.34 mm). Mandibles long and robust, sickle-shaped, the left and right mandibles 1.0—1.13 mm long; the left mandible with a distinct forwardly directed tooth at the middle third near the apex (distance from the tooth to the mandible apex 0.34—0.39 mm). Postmentum flat, length 0.91—1.10 mm, maximum width 0.50—0.63 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, maximum width 0.95—1.20 mm, maximum length 0.63—0.67 mm. Cerci 0.11 mm long; styli single-segmented, 0.07 mm long.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule pale yellow to yellowish brown. Body length 4.25—4.45 mm; head nearly square, wider than long, width 1.44—1.47 mm, length 1.26—1.33 mm. Antennae 16—17-segmented, segment 1 longest, segment 4 shortest. Left mandible with 1 apical tooth and 3 marginal teeth. Pronotum saddle-shaped, width 0.84—0.88 mm, length 0.46—0.49 mm; anterior margin deeply concave in the middle. Tibial apical spur formula 3:2:2; tarsi 4-segmented. Cerci 2-segmented, 0.11 mm long; styli 0.70 mm long. Minor worker: similar to the major worker, only smaller.
